rationale: Node 22.14.0 satisfies Vite 8.2.2 and plugin-react-swc 4.3.3. Vitest 4.1.11 declares both a dependency and peer range that includes Vite 8, removing the current Vitest 3.x embedded Vite 7 mismatch. Keep the installed Vite and SWC exact versions and upgrade only Vitest to the compatible exact release.

queries.vite: npm view vite@8.2.2 version engines peerDependencies --json
queries.vitest: npm view vitest@4.1.11 version engines dependencies.vite peerDependencies --json
